name: pictionary-live
description: Real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game (Skribbl.io style)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run start:prod" "npm --prefix client run preview"
